name: Pieter van der Merwe
bio:
Pieter's journey in motorsport began in his father's small engineering workshop outside Johannesburg. He spent his youth learning the intricacies of metalwork and engine repair, skills he honed through apprenticeships at local racing teams. His dedication to precision and problem-solving quickly made him a sought-after fabricator.

He joined EVO Racing Team fifteen years ago and has been instrumental in several of the team's successes, particularly in designing and implementing innovative chassis reinforcements. Pieter is known for his meticulous approach, favoring tried-and-tested methods over flashy new technologies. His loyalty to the team and his unwavering commitment to quality are what set him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A sturdy man of medium height, Pieter has the weathered hands of someone who has spent his life working with metal.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool.
Insists on using imperial measurements alongside metric, causing occasional confusion.
Has a peculiar habit of whistling while welding, often off-key.
